Subject: Auric Capital - request: combined credits + discount for 60-day pilot

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick one — Auric Capital (Kelly Park, procurement looped) has asked for an accelerated pilot that includes both a meaningful rate concession and a starter credit pool. They are evaluating us against two competitors and pricing flexibility is the deciding factor.

Commercial ask (proposal we want to push for exec approval):
- 60-day pilot (starts on signature)
- $25,000 in free Redwood credits to offset usage during pilot
- 35% discount off list for first 12 months if they convert within 90 days of pilot end
- Standard SOW + DoD security checklist (they've attached requirements)

Why approve:
- Auric is a mid-market fintech with immediate production intent; initial forecasted ARR if converted: ~$360k/yr.
- They have compliance needs but seem willing to sign a standard SOW and provide a short PO.
- Competitive pressure: competitors are offering shorter pilots with smaller credits. This package materially improves our win probability.

Risks / asks:
- We are asking for a non-standard combination (credits + discount). Need exec signoff for combined concession > $20k.
- Legal/Finance will need to review the term-sheet (attached).

Attaching: auric_term-sheet_v2.pdf, auric_security_requirements.xlsx

Can you both weigh in? If you think this is approvable, we'll escalate to Aditya for final signoff.

Thanks,
Camila

Adding commercial detail to help the ask:

Customer background:
- Auric Capital (fintech) — pilot will cover two high-throughput inference routes (KYC screening + personalization embeddings).
- They have immediate production timelines (QA in April, go-live May if pilot goes well).

Proposed structured concession:
- Pilot: 60 days starting on SOW signature.
- Credits: $25k free credits that will be applied as invoice credits (roll-forward allowed only if they convert to a paid account within 90 days of pilot end).
- Discount: 35% off list for 12 months if they sign within 90 days of pilot completion.
- Additional ask: customer will sign a 12-month MSA and issue an initial PO to demonstrate commitment.

Forecast / ROI:
- Expected OTE if they adopt: $360k ARR (our ops model shows a payback within 8 months).
- Opportunity is time-sensitive because competitor X is offering a 30% discount but no credits.

Why we need exec approval: combined credits + discount > $20k in expected concession. Legal/Finance will need to confirm the credit accounting treatment and that the roll-forward clause is enforceable.

If Aditya is comfortable, we ask for conditional signoff so we can present a single term-sheet to the customer tomorrow.

-Ben
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Auric Capital - request: combined credits + discount for 60-day pilot

Thanks for the clear summary. I'm comfortable with a concession here if we narrow the scope and add guardrails. Conditional approval below — please operationalize these before sending to Auric: 

Approved commercial package (conditional):
- Pilot: 45 days (shorten from 60)
- Credits: $20,000 applied as invoice credits during pilot; credits are non-refundable but will be fully credited against invoices.
- Discount: 30% off list for 12 months if they convert within 60 days of pilot end.

Conditions / guardrails:
1) Customer must sign the MSA + SOW with the term-sheet we attached. No verbal commitments.
2) Credits only roll forward if legal confirms conversion clause; Finance to confirm accounting treatment before signature.
3) Require a PO or signed commitment >= $50k to trigger the credit grant.
4) Product to confirm the two inference routes are supported under our dedicated runtime profile (Camila to attach route IDs).

Rationale: this preserves upside while limiting exposure; it also speeds timeline which Auric prefers. If Legal/Finance flag anything material, revert.

Marissa/Ben, set HubSpot deal stage to "Executive Approved - Pending Docs" and paste this thread. Camila, please confirm you can present this version tomorrow.

- Aditya Rao
VP Revenue | Redwood Inference
